content_descriptors.notes: The player takes on the role of a doctor, with scenes of nudity presented through the interface when examining patients' bodies, alongside depictions of blood and various injuries. Dialogues may include strong language, and characters might consume alcohol, drugs or tobacco depending on the narrative context. Suicide can occur if the player fails objectives that arise during the story.

name: Pathologic 3 Demo
short_description: In this psychological horror game, you are a doctor with only 12 days to save a town from a mysterious plague. Make ruthless decisions and diagnose with precision. Shape the town's future and rewrite the past. Hold yourself together while it all falls apart.
supported_languages: English, Russian, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil
